Examples: Name, account handle, address, phone, exact personal identifier
Default handling: Do not ingest into ordinary research workflows; isolate under strict controls
Allowed research output: No raw output; only approved de-identified or aggregate result
Retention and disclosure: Shortest viable retention; no public export

Examples: Accessibility preferences, assistive interaction settings, device/communication configuration, private continuity boundaries
Default handling: Treat as sensitive; collect only when directly needed for access support
Allowed research output: Aggregated accessibility findings or user-controlled summaries
Retention and disclosure: No inference about identity, health, augmentation, capability, or eligibility

Examples: Model features, statistical transformations, pseudonymous aggregates
Default handling: Treat as potentially re-identifiable; review linkability and feature leakage
Retention and disclosure: Delete or re-evaluate when purpose expires or source conditions change

Examples: Methods, aggregate findings, uncertainty intervals, reproducibility materials
Default handling: Preserve provenance, uncertainty, limitations, and review context
Allowed research output: Public only after disclosure and re-identification review

Examples: Consent receipts, policy decisions, appeal records, material-change reviews
Retention and disclosure: Preserve under defined governance schedule; redacted output only

Examples: Authentication failures, authorization denials, integrity alerts, anomalous access events
Default handling: Minimize event payload; segregate from research data
Retention and disclosure: Retain under incident and security policy, with strict role-based access
